description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Amend the Gaz.Ex.No. 2047/02 of 27.11.2017 : (Rates of CESS On Footwear)
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory instrument that amends the CESS rates on various footwear articles under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979. It contains a statutory order with a detailed schedule of tariff codes and rates, making it primarily about regulatory framework modifications rather than government personnel, structure, or other specialized categories.
